source: fresh git worktree list --porcelain plus per-worktree git status --porcelain=v1 --ignored=matching
exclusionRule: Only a verified Junction targeting the primary .local-inputs is skipped. Owned directories and unexpected reparse points are reported.

classifications.worktreeOwnedLocalInputs: Inventory exact owned directories, hashes and sizes; move to a verified destination before removal.
classifications.reproducibleCacheCandidate: Only __pycache__/ and the exact port/android-native .gradle, app/.cxx, app/build, and build paths; candidate after source snapshots and root approval.
classifications.preserveBeforeRemoval: Every ignored file or directory outside that exact cache allowlist; hash-copy or archive under primary .local-inputs/cleanup-preserved first.

ignoredPaths.reason: Worktree-owned ignored data is unique. Move to an explicit verified destination and compare per-file SHA-256 values before cleanup.
